prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied photograph of a closed rectangular 3D-printed jewellery tin on a pale blue background.
Create a clean neutral product photo for an interactive configurator. Preserve EXACTLY the photographed closed-box perspective, ribbed side-wall geometry, rounded corners, sliding lid perimeter, dimensions, position, lighting, cast shadow and pale-blue background. Remove ALL text and fish graphics from the lid. Remove the pull-tab/hinge from its top surface. Leave one entirely blank light-cream inset top face, with no holes, no writing, no motif and no tab, ready for live artwork compositing. Recolour ONLY all the plastic body, ribs and perimeter rim to the same saturated orange plastic used by a real 3D-printed box. Preserve every rib, seam, highlight and shadow; do not smooth away the geometry. Maintain the low three-quarter angle of the source; the front and right walls must be visible. No additional objects or boxes. Keep landscape canvas 1258×1054 and do not crop the product. The only edits are neutralising the printed lid and making the plastic orange.
